# CrossPoint Reader 1.5.0-7

This release simplifies the built-in font set and improves reading statistics and time estimates on Xteink X4.

## Added

- Added a per-book reading-speed estimate based on the latest 20 valid page-reading intervals.
- Added estimated remaining reading time to book statistics and above the progress bar on the home screen.
- Added a confirmation action for clearing an individual book's reading statistics.
- Added a chart-spline icon for reading statistics.

## Changed

- Nunito is now the only built-in font family and is used for both the interface and books.
- Durations now use up to two highest time units, including seconds and days.
- Book statistics now focus on reading time, reading speed, and estimated time remaining.
- Global statistics no longer display session and page-turn counts.

## Fixed

- Reading sessions shorter than one minute with no page turns are no longer counted.
- Page intervals shorter than 5 seconds or longer than 2 minutes are excluded from reading-speed estimates.
- Clearing book statistics preserves the book's completed status.

## Notes

- Reading speed is calculated independently for each book after 10 valid page samples are available.
- This release contains firmware for Xteink X4 only.
